title: Childhood kidney infection and hospital stay
summary: He was a sickly child born with an infected kidney and spent a long time in hospital with a drainage tube.

blocks.x: But before that time, I had a--I was always sort of a sickly type fellow. I was born with a affective infected kidney. And I stayed in the hospital for a long time--almost a year and a half--because of the--now, you know, what they--they wasn't up on the medicine that they are today. Where today, that they can give you a pill which can flush your kidneys, clean all the flames and stuff around your kidneys. And you're fine. You know what I mean?
But uh, at that time they had to operate and put a tube into my side, you know.
And therefore, to drain with a jug on the floor with a thing running from my side into this jug which was--would drain all this pus and stuff from around my kidneys.
